name: test_type_spelling
summary: Input: two grants on EXTERNAL_TABLE (GRANTS_TO_ROLES spelling) and EXTERNAL TABLE (SHOW spelling). Expected: both objects get kind EXTERNAL TABLE; DATABASE_ROLE links keep the underscore and still build database roles.

name: test_inventory
summary: Input: Direct mode on fake SHOW answers plus two notebooks no role owns (empty owner, an APPLICATION owner). Expected: one OWNERSHIP row per object (none doubled with real grants), Streamlit apps and notebooks owned by their schema OWNER role, unowned objects listed with no holder, the objects source 'ACCOUNT_USAGE + SHOW' and a note that lists only failures.

name: test_blocked
summary: Input: fake users whose read role lacks USAGE on the schema or database, plus a tiny data set with a database role. Expected: can() returns blocked [('SCHEMA','DW.SANDBOX')], gap_text 'no USAGE on schema DW.SANDBOX', an unblock IaC text and GRANT; a second role with USAGE, an admin holder and an account object are never blocked; who_has marks 'no schema USAGE'; a database role has its own database, a future USAGE grant does not count.

name: test_admin_real_links
summary: Input: the fake data, then a user holding only SECURITYADMIN. Expected: SYSADMIN reaches only the roles granted to it, ACCOUNTADMIN at least SYSADMIN + SECURITYADMIN; SECURITYADMIN / USERADMIN / ORGADMIN own no objects; DW's sandbox table has no admin reader; the SECURITYADMIN-only user is an admin holder but not a reader in who_has, matrix, sensitive_rank, flow_sets or review_grid.

name: test_object_activity
summary: Input: the fake ACCESS_HISTORY and QUERY_HISTORY, then a BASE-only read, a PUBLIC built-in view, reads 29/31/89/92 days back and OBJECT_USE missing. Expected: every age bucket present; read_only / write_only / both / none patterns per window (90 days: 5/1/1/29); procedures, functions and tasks 'nodata'; warehouses from QUERY_HISTORY with 30 days of history; a BASE read counts as a read; built-ins never listed; window edges by day; no ACCESS_HISTORY gives 'nodata' with a note, never 'not used'.

name: test_describe_not_ddl
summary: Input: an ACCESS_HISTORY row with ACTION DDL and QUERY_TYPE DESCRIBE. Expected: the row becomes ACTION READ, no rule 24 finding mentions DESCRIBE, and ACT_BASE holds LIKE 'DESCRIBE%'.

name: test_twin
summary: Input: twin.twin(0.02), the synthetic twin of a big account at a fiftieth. Expected: the same data on every run, a finding for each of rules 1-29, and users / roles / objects within 30% of the profile counts times the scale.

name: test_object_admin_rows
summary: Input: GET /api/object?name=FINANCE.REPORT.TBL_REVENUE. Expected: OPS_01 (reached only via SYSADMIN) has admin ['SYSADMIN'], depth 2, a shortest path through the schema OWNER role, a SELECT cell titled 'via SYSADMIN', flags on OWNERSHIP and the DML privileges; a service user is not flagged; a disabled user's status flag starts 'Disabled'.

name: test_focus_keeps_way_in
summary: Input: server.narrow() on a 5-lane graph whose roles-between box is a summary fold, focused on the object. Expected: no note, every box U -> G -> F -> H -> object kept with their lines.

name: test_crowded_lane
summary: Input: build_graph with MAX_LANE + 6 users in one lane. Expected: fewer than 5 nodes and no single user box: the lane folds into one people box.

name: test_access_type
summary: Input: GET /api/access?user=ENGINEER_01, then &otype=VIEW. Expected: types with counts summing to total; the filtered list has only VIEW objects and its total equals the VIEW count.

name: test_check_narrow
summary: Input: GET /api/check for ANALYST_01 on a Streamlit app with near=1. Expected: verdict no, asked privilege USAGE, the narrowest grant on the schema READ role with GRANT USAGE ON STREAMLIT SQL, a separate nearest_own list ending at the object; none when OWNERSHIP is asked.

name: test_check_inside
summary: Input: GET /api/check on a table, a database (HR_01 on SALES) and a schema with inside=dml / ddl, show_in=can and in_q. Expected: a table has no inside part but DATABASE / SCHEMA USAGE chips; a database with no reach lists every object as cannot; DML on SALES.CORE gives rows the user can with a CREATE TABLE line; DDL needs OWNERSHIP; a search with no match gives 0 rows and keeps the total.

name: test_find_lock_free
summary: Input: /api/find while another thread holds server.LOCK. Expected: the search answers in under 5 s with names only (partial), answer lines once the lock is free, answers only for the first ANSWER_TOP hits; no fuzzy pass over more than FUZZY_MAX names.

name: test_findings_link
summary: Input: GET /api/user and /api/role, then /api/rules?grantee=<name>&of=user|role&sev=all. Expected: the Risks page lists the same findings_total as the User and Role pages.

name: test_review_csv_cap
summary: Input: GET /api/review.csv?db=* with REVIEW_CSV_MAX set below the row count. Expected: csv_max reported; over the cap a 400 whose message says 'pick one database'.

name: test_graph_focus
summary: Input: focus=<box> on /api/map, /api/user, /api/role, /api/object and /api/graph, plus schema / otype / access filters. Expected: only the lines through the focused box; a database box opens into its objects; an unknown focus gives a 'not in this graph' note and the whole graph; filters keep only matching objects; access=delete is a 400; a summary fold whose lines miss its members stays one box.

name: test_rule_by_grantee
summary: Input: GET /api/meta, then /api/rules?rule=18&by=grantee and one group. Expected: rule_counts > 0 for each rule; groups per grantee summing to the rule's total with objects and the most common texts; one group lists only that rule's findings.

name: test_objuse
summary: Input: GET /api/objuse with tab, days, limit, offset, sort, scope, type, q; /api/objuse.csv; /api/home. Expected: tabs unused 30 / read_only 5 / write_only 1 / all 49 at 90 days, never-used first, counts per type and age, server paging and filters, days=7 a 400, a CSV header 'Object,Type,Last read', Home's objuse card with the same counts; off in My access; the page sits in the risk group.

name: test_not_read_and_caps
summary: Input: ACCESS_HISTORY and streams marked UNAVAILABLE, another role prefix on a big account, and capped lists. Expected: activity rules and rule 22 skipped as 'not read' (never passing); rules 1-2 skipped when no role has the prefix; find answers with people + admin holders; capped paths, stale lists and the review_grid cap report totals; the flow CSV lists every person.

name: test_correct_answers
summary: Input: admin users and roles, future grants, an orphan role, Risks and Review filters, the Sensitive catalog. Expected: admin roles always named (never a bare zero); future grants not counted as objects; Request agrees with Can they? for admin holders; the DW sandbox has no admin path; one Nearest list; names in any case; an orphan role suggests no revoke; CSVs follow the screen filters; Hide USAGE rows hides them; admin readers count only what their admin roles reach.

name: test_answer_first
summary: Input: Can they? with near=1, the Sensitive page, Who has access with st= filters, What if dropping a role. Expected: one-step nearest ways carry a GRANT naming the role; the readers tile equals the Who can read count; row-policy roles listed per object; per-state filters match the counts, active first per level; What if groups count every place, not only the listed ones.

name: test_risks
summary: Input: /api/access, /api/role, /api/who and /api/check for admin, disabled, broad, clean and sensitive subjects. Expected: a risk strip of {severity, text, n, link, table} items (table null or 1 to RISK_ROWS rows of total), worst first: admin roles held and admin default role, finding counts with a link listing exactly those findings, unmasked sensitive reads (its table and the Column by column page it opens list those objects, What they see sends the same strip), disabled holders, very broad access, PUBLIC grants, unused-but-readable; clean subjects give []; the Role and Access pages share one function.

name: test_blocked
summary: Input: a small DuckDB snapshot with roles missing schema USAGE, USAGE from another held role, a database role, a future grant, an admin role and an imported database. Expected: TF_CAN's BLOCKED column equals access.gap_text(access.can()) per user ('no USAGE on schema D.S' or none); a shared database needs no schema USAGE.

name: test_objects
summary: Input: the procedure's object inventory against a fake Snowpark session where some ACCOUNT_USAGE / INFORMATION_SCHEMA / SHOW reads are refused. Expected: the inventory functions are the same source as access.py; each object type read from one level only (ACCOUNT_USAGE, then INFORMATION_SCHEMA, then SHOW), notes say why a lower level was used; ungranted objects become OWNERSHIP rows of their owner, objects with an owner grant add nothing, unowned ones have no grantee, databases (shares too) are objects; SHOW-only kinds map to ICEBERG TABLE / MATERIALIZED VIEW and temporary tables are skipped.
